verdict.rationale: Natural-language control of a GPU is conceivable through vendor companion or driver software, so the axis applies. The evidence pack, however, only shows that the card can run AI agents and LLM workloads. Hosting AI workloads is not the same as the product itself being operable through natural-language commands, and no such interface is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
